key_insight: Neuro-VL is a specialized vision-language model that interprets complete neuroimaging examinations and discusses findings in natural language.
clinical_relevance: Its capabilities could support radiology reporting and longitudinal disease assessment, but the abstract does not establish improved patient outcomes.
method: Trained on nearly one million neuroimaging studies from routine clinical care.
Interprets examinations, describes abnormalities and generates radiology reports.
Compares serial examinations and responds to questions about findings.
evidence_signal: Across internal and international datasets, Neuro-VL outperformed general-purpose and specialized medical models on reported imaging tasks and more reliably resisted misleading clinical assumptions.
watch_item: Prospective clinical validation is needed to establish safety and reliability before routine deployment.
paper_title: A frontier machine intelligence for human neuroimaging
